purpose: Backend API for submitting and reviewing admin create/update/archive/delete requests before destructive or catalog-changing work is applied.
businessRules: CHANGE_REVIEWER can approve or reject requests.
CHANGE_MANAGER can both submit and review requests.
SUPER_ADMIN is accepted by the shared admin access guard for all role checks.
Approval applies the request payload through AdminChangeRequestApplier in the same transaction before marking the request approved.
